settings.heading: Made to be worn. Every single day.
settings.subheading: Minimal, waterproof accessories in 18K Gold and Sterling Silver finishes — designed to move through life with you.

settings.heading: Quiet luxury, at an honest price.
settings.text:
BAHRATI began with a simple frustration: accessories either looked beautiful and fell apart, or lasted forever and looked like hardware. We wanted both — pieces refined enough for a dinner table and tough enough for salt water.

So we build every piece from premium 316L stainless steel, seal it in thick 18K gold or sterling silver plating, and back it with a 2-year warranty.

settings.title: Wears like nothing, looks like everything
settings.text: I've had the silver on for three months straight — showers, gym, the sea in July. Still looks the way it did out of the box. It's become part of my hand, honestly.
settings.author: Daniel M.

settings.title: Bought it as a gift, kept it for myself
settings.text: Ordered the gold for my brother's confirmation… then ordered a second one because I couldn't hand it over. The sideways cross is subtle — people notice it without it shouting.
settings.author: Samuel O.

settings.title: Finally one that doesn't turn green
settings.text: I have sensitive skin and every "gold" bracelet I've owned left marks within weeks. This one hasn't — no irritation, no fading. The adjustable chain means it actually fits.
settings.author: Amara K.

settings.title: Quality far above the price
settings.text: The clasp is solid, the chain has real weight to it, and the finish is flawless. It arrived in a beautiful box with a card — felt like a much more expensive purchase.
settings.author: Jesse V.

settings.title: Beautiful — wish I'd sized down
settings.text: Gorgeous bracelet and fast shipping to Canada. I wear it on the tightest setting; if you have a slim wrist you'll still be fine thanks to the extender. Would buy again.
settings.author: Lena T.

settings.title: My daily reminder
settings.text: I wanted something meaningful I could wear everywhere, even where jewelry feels out of place. This is exactly that — quiet, elegant, personal. Customer service was lovely too.
settings.author: Mateo R.

settings.title: Secure Checkout
settings.text: Payments are processed over 256-bit SSL encryption. We never see or store your card details.

settings.title: Buyer Protection
settings.text: Order lost or damaged in transit? We reship or refund in full — every parcel is tracked and insured.

settings.title: 2-Year Warranty
settings.text: If your piece fades, discolours or breaks under normal wear within two years, we replace it free of charge.

settings.heading: Protected, from checkout to wrist.
settings.subheading: Every order is covered — your payment, your delivery and your bracelet itself.

settings.heading: From our studio to your door.
settings.subheading: Orders placed on business days are packed and dispatched within 24 hours, with tracking sent to your inbox.
settings.footnote: Every order arrives in a BAHRATI gift box with a polishing cloth — ready to give, or to keep.

settings.question: Will the bracelet tarnish, fade or turn my skin green?
settings.answer: No. Each bracelet is built on a 316L stainless steel core with a thick 18K gold or sterling silver plating. It's engineered to resist tarnishing, fading and discolouration — and it's covered by our 2-year warranty if it ever lets you down.

settings.question: Can I wear it in the shower, sea or gym?
settings.answer: Yes — that's the point. The bracelet is fully waterproof and sweat-proof. Put it on and forget about it: shower, swim, train, repeat.

settings.question: What size is it? Will it fit my wrist?
settings.answer: One size fits nearly all. The chain adjusts from 16.5 cm to 21 cm using the extender, which covers slim to larger wrists. It's designed to be unisex.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: We dispatch within 24 hours on business days. Delivery typically takes 4–7 business days to the US & Canada, 3–6 to Europe & the UK, and 7–12 to the rest of the world. Every order includes tracking.

settings.question: What if it doesn't suit me?
settings.answer: You have 30 days to return unworn items for a full refund — no questions asked. Just reach out and we'll guide you through it.

settings.question: How does the 2-year warranty work?
settings.answer: If your bracelet fades, discolours or breaks under normal wear within two years of purchase, send us a photo and your order number — we'll ship a replacement free of charge.

settings.question: Is it gift-ready?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order arrives in a BAHRATI gift box with a polishing cloth and care card — no extra wrapping needed.
